videos.caption: 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

videos.caption: UN APAGÓN MASIVO DEJA A OSCURAS BUENA PARTE DE CASABLANCA: INVESTIGAN UN POSIBLE CIBERATAQUE Un importante apagón ha afectado este miércoles, 11 de noviembre, a numerosos barrios de Casablanca, la capital económica de Marruecos, dejando sin suministro eléctrico a viviendas, comercios y diferentes instalaciones de la ciudad. La interrupción también ha provocado problemas de tráfico, fallos en semáforos y dificultades en las comunicaciones. El corte comenzó alrededor de las 16:48 horas y afectó a zonas como Maârif, Sidi Belyout, Bourgogne, Californie, Aïn Chock, Hay Hassani y el centro de Casablanca. También se registraron interrupciones en localidades próximas, entre ellas Bouskoura y Dar Bouazza. Las imágenes difundidas desde la ciudad muestran amplias zonas sin iluminación mientras los servicios técnicos trabajan para recuperar la normalidad. En las primeras horas circularon especulaciones sobre un posible ciberataque contra la infraestructura eléctrica marroquí. Sin embargo, la compañía regional de servicios Casablanca-Settat ha explicado que el incidente se produjo en líneas de muy alta tensión pertenecientes a la red nacional de transporte eléctrico. Según la información comunicada por la empresa, la avería estuvo relacionada con las fuertes rachas de viento y las tormentas que afectaron a la región. El problema interrumpió la alimentación de varias subestaciones que suministran electricidad a distintos sectores de la metrópoli. La falta de corriente dejó semáforos fuera de servicio, provocó dificultades de circulación y obligó a algunos establecimientos a interrumpir su actividad. Los equipos de Casablanca-Settat y de la Oficina Nacional de Electricidad y Agua Potable (ONEE) iniciaron las reparaciones para restablecer el suministro. A lo largo de la tarde y la noche, varios barrios comenzaron a recuperar la electricidad. Fuente: Hespress / Medi1news #CostaDelTerror #Casablanca #Marruecos #Apagon #Ciberseguridad

5 things to know before going to Marrakech👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Moroccan taxis WILL overcharge you, download @inDrive before you arrive. It works at the airport, you set your own price, so there’s no negotiation needed 🚖  2️⃣ Be aware of the animal abuse at Jemaa el-Fnaa. Men walk the square with monkeys in chains and snakes with their teeth removed, don’t pay if they confront you 🙊  3️⃣ Where you stay matters. I found my riad on the @cozycozy app, which compared the prices across all the major booking sites. Agoda was £40 vs £45 on Booking.com, saving £35 over 7 nights 🏨  4️⃣ Eat all the street food. Vendors need licences, so it’s clean, fresh and cheap. I reccoemnd trying this sardine salad just off the main square, search “fried fish” on google maps 🍗  5️⃣ Stay safe in the medina. Wear your backpack on your front, watch out for pickpockets, ignore the men on street corners and download offline maps before you arrive 🎒  Save this video for your trip to Morocco 📌 #marrakech #morocco #jemaaelfna #cozycozy #ad

🇲🇦😍 Marrakech: uma das cidades mais exóticas e fascinantes do Marrocos! Imagine ruas labirínticas, palácios ornamentados, mercados coloridos, jardins exuberantes e uma arquitetura que parece saída de outro tempo. Marrakech é uma explosão de cores, aromas, sabores e cultura no coração do Marrocos! ✨ 📍 O que conhecer em Marrakech: 🕌 Mesquita Koutoubia – um dos cartões-postais mais famosos da cidade. 🏰 Bahia Palace – um palácio magnífico com jardins e detalhes arquitetônicos impressionantes. 🌸 Jardin Majorelle – um jardim famoso pelo azul intenso e pela vegetação exuberante. 🛍️ Medina de Marrakech – um labirinto de ruas, lojas e mercados tradicionais. 🧡 Jemaa el-Fna – a praça mais famosa da cidade, cheia de movimento e cultura. 🏛️ Ben Youssef Madrasa – uma antiga escola islâmica com arquitetura deslumbrante. 🚪 Bab Agnaou – um dos portões históricos mais impressionantes da cidade. 🌴 El Badi Palace – as ruínas de um antigo palácio de proporções grandiosas. 🧖 Hammam tradicional – uma experiência cultural de banho e relaxamento marroquino. Marrakech é um destino que desperta todos os sentidos e mostra um lado completamente diferente do mundo. Four days in Marrakech, Morocco and I already can't wait to go back! 🇲🇦✨ If you’re planning your first trip to Morocco, Marrakech is the perfect place to dive into the country’s rich culture, incredible food, and beautiful architecture. Between getting lost in the medina, learning to cook traditional Moroccan dishes, and enjoying a little luxury in the Agafay Desert, we packed SO much into four days! One thing I loved most about Marrakech was how every day felt completely different. You can spend one morning exploring centuries of history and the next relaxing poolside with views of the Atlas Mountains. And the hospitality? Some of the best I’ve experienced. 🥹 My biggest recommendation is to leave some room in your Marrakech itinerary to wander, shop, and enjoy the city without rushing from one attraction to the next. 📌 Save this 4-day Marrakech itinerary for your Morocco vacation, and tell me: Would you rather spend a day exploring the souks or relaxing in the Agafay Desert? #MarrakechMorocco #MarrakechItinerary #MoroccoTravel #VisitMarrakech #blacktravelblogger things to do in Marrakech, Marrakech itinerary
